text:
Nina (PM): Short handoff  preparing DP cohort. Need invite + ops SLA.
Lena (ProdOps): What must be on the invite?
Nina (PM): Use-case + sessions (3x30m), infra preference, screener link, NDA, stipend.
Raj (Eng): Add qps & token estimate, region, and a 'dedicated?' checkbox so we route correctly.
Tyler (Sales): Add 'can demo in 2w?' checkbox for fast onboarding candidates.
Maya (Legal): Note: on-prem or HSM requests need SOW/legal review. Also include a brief data-handling line.
Lena (ProdOps): Draft invite (short): ```Hi {name}, Redwood is running a private beta to test latency/cost for your flow. Commitment: ~3 sessions (30m) over 4-6 weeks. Tell us: use-case, qps & tokens/request, infra preference (hosted/dedicated/private), demo window. Screener: https://go.redwood/dp-screener NDA: https://go.redwood/nda Stipend: $400. Reply to accept or ask Qs.```
Nina (PM): Add metrics well measure: "p50/p95, tokens/request, fail rate, and subjective quality delta."
Raj (Eng): SLA proposal: ProdOps ack <24h, Eng triage for infra/legal blockers <48h, PM scope decision <72h. Escalate Dedicated-ops within 12h for dedicated infra asks.
Lena (ProdOps): I'll post a tiny triage matrix + runbook in Confluence and tag owners (steward @Lena, backup @Raj).
Tyler (Sales): I'll start funneling candidates into #dp-invite-2026 tomorrow.
Lena (ProdOps): Final checklist posted: https://go.redwood/confluence/dp-invite-runbook :white_check_mark:
Nina (PM): Great, I'll update roadmap notes with cohort acceptance criteria and timeline.
